name: Applied Nutrition Plc
summary: Applied Nutrition Plc, established in 2014 and based in Liverpool, United Kingdom, specializes in the international manufacture, wholesale, and retail of sports nutritional products. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes a diverse array of protein supplements such as whey, whey isolate, casein, clear, vegan, and beef protein, available in various formats including powders, bars, oats, and ready-to-drink shakes or cans. The company also offers essential performance aids like BCAAs (in powders, tablets, and canned beverages), creatine, other amino acid supplements, and energy solutions such as gels, drinks, and pre-workout formulas. For hydration and vitality, customers can choose from vitamin water, effervescent tablets, electrolyte powders, energy shots, caffeine capsules, and mass gainers. Beyond athletic performance, Applied Nutrition Plc addresses general well-being with products for liver support, a dedicated vitality range, collagen, vitamins, and specialized cooking ingredients. Completing its offerings, the company provides branded merchandise and accessories, including gym clothing, bags, bottles, shakers, funnels, scoops, and digital watches. These extensive product lines are marketed under its distinct brands: Applied Nutrition, ABE All Black Everything, BodyFuel, and Endurance.
